### `lib/src/epoch_picture.dart`

- **function** `MediaLocation? epochPictureFor(FilmProject project, EntityGroup group, String? epoch, Entity entity)` — The picture for [group] at [epoch], whose version in use is [entity] (§9.0).

### `lib/src/media_fetch.dart`

- **enum `MediaFetchStatus`** — Where one media file of a film stands for this device (§6.14).
  - values: `remote`, `fetching`, `local`, `failed`
- **class `MediaFetchState`** — One change of one media file's [MediaFetchStatus], as a tile or a viewer redraws from it.
  - `const MediaFetchState({ required this.filmKey, required this.fileName, required this.status, this.progress, this.code, })` — Names the film by its key and the file by its name in the media folder.
  - `final String filmKey` — The film's key (`projectSourceKey`).
  - `final String fileName` — The file's name in the film's media folder.
  - `final MediaFetchStatus status` — Where the file stands.
  - `final double? progress` — The download's progress from 0 to 1 while [MediaFetchStatus.fetching], where known.
  - `final String? code` — A safe code where [MediaFetchStatus.failed].
- **class `MediaFetchProblem`** — A download a read needed and could not have: its safe [code] only (§6.14).
  - `const MediaFetchProblem(this.code)` — Keeps the download's safe code, such as `notAvailable` or the fetch job's own.
  - `final String code` — The download's safe code.
- **class `MediaFetch`** — The seam that downloads a remote-only media file before it is read; the default does nothing (§6.14).
  - `const MediaFetch()` — Lets an implementation be constant.
  - `static MediaFetch current` — Starts as [NoMediaFetch]; the application installs its own.
  - `static void Function(String event, Map<String, Object?> data)? log` — Hears the store's own lines; the application installs its log here.
  - `Future<void> ensureLocal(ProjectSource source, String fileName, {String reason = 'read'})` — Answers once the media file [fileName] of the film [source] holds is local: at once where the source has it, else after downloading it where the sync has it.
  - `bool isRemote(String filmKey, String fileName)` — Whether [fileName] of the film [filmKey] is on the target only, so a picture of it would download it.
  - `Stream<MediaFetchState> get states` — Every change of a file's status, for the widgets that show it.
  - `static Future<void> ensureIn(MediaStore store, String fileName, {required String reason})` — Ensures [fileName] is local before a reader of [store] reads it: a store of a project's media folder only; any other store's files are its own (§6.14).
- **class `NoMediaFetch`** — The seam where nothing is remote: every file is read as it is.
  - `const NoMediaFetch()` — Starts no listener.

### `lib/src/media_provenance.dart`

- **class `MediaFact`** — One of an entry's facts — its length or its size — as the entry and its record each say it (§6.9).
  - `const MediaFact({this.entry, this.record})`
  - `final int? entry` — What the entry says; null where it says nothing.
  - `final int? record` — What the record's item says; null where no record names the media or the item says nothing.
  - `int? get drawn` — The value to draw: the record's where it has one, else the entry's.
  - `bool get disagrees` — Whether the entry and its record both say it and say it differently, which the tooltip names.
- **class `MediaProvenance`** — What is known of a placed render: its status, when it was asked, what changed since, when it was kept, and its facts beside its record's (§6.9).
  - `const MediaProvenance({ required this.status, this.askedAt, this.changes = const [], this.keptAt, this.duration = const MediaFact(), this.width = c…`
  - `factory MediaProvenance.of(FilmProject project, Map<String, dynamic> document, MediaEntry entry, { String? group, String? block, ProjectMedia? medi…` — What is known of [entry] as [document] shows it, its record read from [project] (§6.9).
  - `final MediaStatus status` — Whether what it was rendered from has changed since.
  - `final DateTime? askedAt` — When its render was asked; null for an upload and where the record does not say.
  - `final List<MediaChange> changes` — What changed after it was asked, in the order the rule reads them; empty unless [status] is outdated.
  - `final DateTime? keptAt` — When a person kept it; null until then.
  - `final MediaFact duration` — Its length in milliseconds, 0 for a still.
  - `final MediaFact width` — Its width in pixels.
  - `final MediaFact height` — Its height in pixels.
  - `final Map<String, Object?>? from` — The take as a render continued from it receives it: the record's stem, the take's item, the record's request and top container whole, its seed applied and its way; null where the record asked nothing.

### `lib/src/media_status.dart`

- **enum `MediaStatus`** — A placed render's standing against what it was rendered from (§6.9).
  - values: `current`, `outdated`, `unknown`
  - `static MediaStatus of(FilmProject project, Map<String, dynamic> document, MediaEntry entry, { String? group, String? block, })` — The status of [entry] as [document] shows it, its record read from [project] (§6.9).
  - `static MediaStatus fromChanges(List<MediaChange>? changes)` — The status [changes] give, as `MediaChange.after` answers them: unknown for null, current for none.
- **enum `MediaChangeKind`** — What a change that outdates a render was made to.
  - values: `document`, `block`, `coverage`, `source`, `stage`
- **class `MediaChange`** — One thing a render depended on that changed after it was asked (§6.9).
  - `const MediaChange({required this.kind, this.at, this.position, this.stem, this.renderStage, this.holderStage})`
  - `final MediaChangeKind kind` — What changed.
  - `final DateTime? at` — When it changed, as its `updated` says; null for a [MediaChangeKind.coverage] and a [MediaChangeKind.stage].
  - `final int? position` — The 1-based position of a [MediaChangeKind.block] among the document's blocks, the count the editor shows.
  - `final String? stem` — The version stem of a [MediaChangeKind.source].
  - `final MediaStage? renderStage` — The stage a [MediaChangeKind.stage]'s render was asked at.
  - `final MediaStage? holderStage` — The stage the holder of a [MediaChangeKind.stage]'s render is at now, above [renderStage].
  - `static List<MediaChange>? after(FilmProject project, RenderBatch? batch, Map<String, dynamic> document, MediaEntry entry, { String? group, String?…` — What changed after [batch]'s render was asked, for [entry] as [document] shows it; null where unknown.

### `lib/src/prompt_inputs.dart`

- **class `PromptToken`** — One piece of media a prompt may name: its token, whose it is, and its entry.
  - `const PromptToken({ required this.token, required this.holder, required this.holderName, required this.word, required this.n, required this.entry, })` — Describes the [n]th usable entry of [word]'s group on [holder].
  - `final String token` — The token as a prompt writes it: `@inspiration-1`, or in a frame `@ch_kira:character_sheet-1`.
  - `final String holder` — The stem of the file whose media it is: the version being edited, or in a frame the version in use.
  - `final String holderName` — The holder's display name, as the version in use says it.
  - `final String word` — The token's word: `inspiration`, `reference`, `character_sheet` or `location_sheet` ([mediaTokenGroups]).
  - `final int n` — The entry's position among its group's usable entries, from 1.
  - `final MediaEntry entry` — The entry it names.
  - `String get group` — The group [word] names.
  - `bool get scoped` — Whether the token names its holder, as a frame's do.
  - `ReferenceTarget get target` — The codec's target for this token.
- **function** `bool isPromptInput(MediaEntry entry)` — Whether [entry] may be sent to a model as a prompt's input.
- **function** `List<PromptToken> promptTokenCandidates(FilmProject project, Entity document, String kind, {required Author? viewer})` — The tokens a prompt of the writers' [kind] on [document] may name for [viewer], in order (§9.8).
- **function** `({List<String> own, Map<EntityType, List<String>> film}) promptTokenGroups(String kind)` — The media groups a prompt of the writers' [kind] names, its own file's or the film's per type (§9.8).
- **function** `({List<PromptToken> inputs, List<String> missing}) promptInputsOf(String text, List<PromptToken> candidates)` — What [text]'s media tokens name among [candidates], and the tokens that name none.
- **function** `String substitutePromptTokens(String words, List<PromptToken> inputs, String placeholders)` — [words] with each media token naming one of [inputs] written in the model's [placeholders] (§9.8).
